subject: Downtime remediation request — service interruption 2025-06-05
messages:
From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@fluxretail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Jun 2025 08:10:00 -0000
Subject: Service outage on 2025-06-05 — request for remediation and credits

Hi Monica,

We saw a sustained degradation on 2025-06-05 between ~02:15–03:40 UTC where our embeddings/generation requests returned 503s and token latencies were elevated (~3–4x baseline). Impacted several checkout flows and a handful of customer-facing batch jobs. We opened a support ticket but wanted to escalate the remediation/compensation conversation directly.

Can we get a goodwill credit for the window and a short trial extension while we stabilize? We rely on Redwood for a lot of late-night processing and this window caused reprocessing and a noticeable spike in downstream errors.

I’ve attached a short log snippet and a billing snapshot for the affected day. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful — availability this morning until 11am UTC.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Lee
Head of Platform
FluxRetail

Attachments: incident_log_20250605.txt, billing_snapshot_20250605.csv
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@fluxretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Service outage on 2025-06-05 — request for remediation and credits

Hi Sam — thank you for the note and the artifacts, and I’m sorry for the disruption. I’ve looped in Marcus (AM) and Neha (Customer Success) so we can coordinate a remediation path quickly.

Quick asks from our side to speed this up:
- Can you confirm the total spend for the billing day in question (or the portion you believe was wasted due to retries)?
- Any internal SLA/commitment language you want us to reference for a formal makewhole?

We’ll propose a concrete credit + promotional extension and get an approval route started today. I’m available 10–11 UTC if you want to chat.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@fluxretail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@fluxretail.com
Date: Sat, 7 Jun 2025 10:24:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Service outage on 2025-06-05 — request for remediation and credits

Thanks Monica — apologies for the late reply. Per our billing team the total spend that day was $3,420 and roughly $1,150 of that looks like retry-related excess. We don’t need the whole amount credited; a proportional credit plus a two-week trial extension for our pilot customers would be ideal (gives us runway to re-run jobs and validate).

For context, our SLA target is 99.9% and the incident clearly pushed us below that for a ~1.5 hour window. We’d like the credit to be applied to the June invoice and any promo extension to be applied to our active trial/referral program code.

Attached the full log slice and a CSV from billing with line items highlighted.

—Sam

Attachments: incident_log_20250605.txt, billing_snapshot_20250605.csv
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 15:11:00 -0000
Subject: FW: Service outage on 2025-06-05 — request for remediation and credits

Marcus / Neha — forwarding Sam’s notes and artifacts. Proposal below:

Proposal (pre-approval):
- One-time usage credit equal to 25% of the excess retry-related spend (~$287) applied to June invoice (keeps finance clean).
- A two-week promotional trial extension for FluxRetail’s pilot customers (apply via promo code FLX-EXT-2W).
- A short postmortem email to Sam summarizing root cause and mitigation actions once engineering has finalized a timeline (ETA: 48h).

Rationale: keeps goodwill reasonable, avoids a full refund request, and provides runway for their pilot. Sam asked for a proportional credit + trial extension.

Please reply with explicit approval or edits so I can send the confirmation to FluxRetail. If we want to escalate to legal/finance for a different structure (larger credit or SLA reprieve), call it out here.

—Monica
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Sam Lee <sam.lee@fluxretail.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 17:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Service outage on 2025-06-05 — request for remediation and credits

Sam — thanks for the details and patience. I reviewed the artifacts with Finance and Engineering. We’ll issue the proposed remediation:

1) One-time credit of $300 applied to your June invoice (covers the retry-related excess and a small goodwill buffer).
2) Two-week promotional extension applied to your pilot customers via promo code FLX-EXT-2W (effective immediately).

Neha will follow up with an engineering summary and a short list of mitigation steps; we aim to share that within 48 hours. I’ve also logged the support ticket SUP-9812 for traceability.

Sam — apologies again for the disruption. We value FluxRetail as a partner and want to make this right. Let me know if you’d like an executive call; otherwise I’ll confirm once the credit is posted.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
